'''Renefra Ren''' was an [[Elomin/Legends|Elomin]] who served the [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitorius]], an order of [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] who were affiliated with the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Ren was the apprentice of Inquisitor [[Probus Tesla]] and in about [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]], Tesla and Ren were posted to serve on the Imperial installation [[Kantaros Station]], in the [[Both system]]. Following the arrival of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] on the [[Space station/Legends|station]], Ren made his way to Tesla's quarters and alerted his master to Vader's presence.
